notes: docx-cli reader gap (not an OfficeCLI defect): `footers list` and read show the cached field result 'Page 1 of 1' instead of {page}/{pages} tokens, although footer1.xml has complex PAGE/NUMPAGES fields and Word renders 'Page N of 3'. docx validate reports only w14:paraId/textId attribute errors, which are mc:Ignorable noise.
weakAgentStruggle: The agent reached a correct result but hit several traps. `set --prop font=Garamond` on Heading1/Title left theme font attributes in place (the readback said Garamond while Word would use the theme font), so it raw-replaced rFonts. A header/footer added to '/' covered only the last section, so it added one to each section. '\n' in add paragraph made new paragraphs, and it had to find '\v' (written '\\v' in JSON). The footer's size=9pt applied only to the first run. The --grid contact-sheet render was misleading. Section indexing was confusing. Each OfficeCLI behavior here was silent or misleading, but the agent caught every one.
